placement_fees.source: Empregga, a national SME recruitment marketplace (3.000+ companies, per its own page). Managed service: an HR specialist plus AI pre-selection delivers 2 finalists, success-only, one payment per vacancy
placement_fees.price: 'ticket médio de R$1.516 por vaga' (the vendor's own illustrative figure). The recruiter keeps 50% = R$758 per hire. Replacement guarantee is an OPTIONAL add-on per vacancy (+30 or +60 days), not free. The price is a 'valor de tabela, definido pela faixa salarial do cargo'
placement_fees.basis: per filled vacancy, one-time; the average covers ALL salary bands, so a R$2.000–2.500 role should sit at or below it
placement_fees.status: seller-published average (primary vendor page, fetched 25 Sep 2026); not a clearing price for this role

placement_fees.source: Empregga recruiter-side economics: the market's own figure for what a solo recruiter earns
placement_fees.price: R$758 per hire to the recruiter. Worked example: 4 vagas/month = R$3.032/month, labelled 'É onde a maioria das Recrutadoras começa'. The plan costs R$490/month

placement_fees.source: Atle R&S proposal (real proposal PDF, ~2015: the minimum wage is shown as R$788)
placement_fees.price: 60% of one month's salary for R$788–2.000; 55% for R$2.000,01–4.000; 50% above. That is ≈R$1.100–1.375 at a R$2.000–2.500 host base. Payment 30% at opening and 70% at completion
placement_fees.basis: % of one monthly salary per placement

placement_fees.source: Free job posting: the brand's do-it-yourself route
placement_fees.price: R$0. Catho: 'Infinitas vagas gratuitas… anunciar vagas gratuitamente e de forma ilimitada'. Empregga: 'Publicar vaga é gratuito… sem limite… decisão permanente', with AI that writes the ad and scores applicants with a match score. br.trabajo.org: 'Publique vagas gratuitamente'. Recruta Simples: 5-day free trial, then paid (price not on the page), multiposting to '+100 sites'

free_front_door: STRONG, and it fires on three layers. (1) THE BRAND DOES IT ITSELF FOR FREE, AND ALMOST ALL DO. I paginated br.trabajo.org to the end on four queries (apresentadora live tiktok · apresentador de live · live seller · host de live): 792 unique URLs, of which only 84 are genuine live-host listings. Collapsing aggregator duplicates (Netvagas, vagas.sc, 'Confidencial') leaves ~54 distinct hiring entities, 51 of them with a post in the last 30 days. Only 5–6 of the 54 (≈10–12%) use an intermediary: Talent & Tech, Comunica RH, RHEVO, Lestars, Jobbol, and possibly RH Shopping. Correction to W2E: Recruta Simples is a self-serve multiposting TOOL ('Anuncie sua vaga em +100 sites com um clique', 5-day free trial), not a recruiter, so StarLive recruits in-house. ~88–90% of employers post themselves, on boards that cost R$0 and now ship AI screening (Empregga's match score, Catho's 'pré-seleção inteligente'). Gupy, the ATS of larger companies, holds only 2 live-host roles in 60 days (Pacco, Dafyne): the employers are small. (2) THE LIVE AGENCIES RECRUIT IN-HOUSE, AND FOR TRAINABILITY, NOT SELECTION. Tec-Do: 'Sem experiência necessária… + treinamento', R$4.000–5.500. Commerce Lab: 'Treinamento completo em vendas ao vivo, sem necessidade de experiência prévia'. Oceanix: 'Não é necessário ter experiência'. iGoal, Agência Fuzze, Synco Live, Speed Agency and Lestars all post their own ads. In ~41 of 84 ads, live experience is a 'diferencial', not a requirement. So the agency pack (3 hires for R$5.000) sells selection to buyers who have decided selection is cheap and training is the lever. (3) THE PLATFORM FUNDS LIVE-TALENT RECRUITMENT AND TRAINING. TikTok LIVE's Agências (Creator Networks) programme pays agencies 'bônus mensais' from incentive programmes. It gives them free scouting in LIVE Backstage ('ver uma lista de possíveis criadores e aproveitar os programas de indicação'). This is on the entertainment/gifting side, and it creates a large, platform-paid talent-agency layer (e.g., Bellucci Assessoria, 'recrutamento, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de streamers, hosts'). TikTok Shop BR TSP categories fund 'LIVE Stream Management … host training' and 'Mass Tutoring … classes for … hosting EC live' for Brazil. And the seller's Affiliate Center 'Descobrir criadores' finds commission-only affiliate live-sellers free: Johnson's Baby logged 727 hours of affiliate lives. W2E is right that 'Host/Operations Recruitment and Training' is listed for cross-border and UK, not Brazil. (Separately, 'Mass Recruiting' in BR means SELLER onboarding, not host recruiting.) ⇒ What a brand gets from her that a free post does not: sourcing from people ALREADY selling on TikTok LIVE, plus a taped audition on its own product judged by a casting-trained eye. That is real but narrow. The brand can reproduce the audition with a paid trial live, and the market treats the rest as trainable. ★ THE PRICE-HOLDER IS MIS-ASSIGNED. TikTok's rule ('Não use interações verbais que não sejam em tempo real, como vozes geradas por IA', re-read at the saved BR academy page) creates demand for a human HOST. The host captures that consent at her wage: R$1.620–5.500 base + commission across the 84 ads. Consent is ABUNDANT: 500 mil criadores (TikTok's fashion lead, Sep 2025), ads hiring 'sem experiência', and a free platform channel to reach creators. It gives the intermediary no pricing power. This is the same correction the archive made to the residence seat: 'the buyer cannot BE this' is worth nothing when thousands can be it instead.
law: (a) Lei 6.533/78 art. 3 par. único + art. 4 (planalto, read today): the law applies to 'pessoas físicas ou jurídicas que agenciem colocação de mão-de-obra' of ARTISTS, who 'deverão ser previamente inscritas no Ministério do Trabalho'. ★ The regulation is stricter than W2E reported. Decreto 82.385/78 art. 5 par. único: 'Somente as empresas organizadas e registradas no Ministério do Trabalho, nos termos da Lei nº 6.019… poderão agenciar colocação de mão-de-obra de Artista'. A Lei 6.019 temporary-work firm needs 'capital social de, no mínimo, R$ 100.000,00' (art. 6 III, Lei 13.429/2017), i.e., 40–200× her capital. IF a live host is an 'artista', she cannot lawfully place one. (b) Is the host an artista? Probably NOT for beauty/fragrance/accessory lives. Art. 2 I defines an artist as one who 'interpreta ou executa obra de caráter cultural… através de meios de comunicação de massa'. The Decreto 82.385 quadro anexo (full text at SATED-MA) lists no 'apresentador' function. Every observed ad frames the job as SALES: 'vendedora', metas, comissão, CLT/PJ. ⚠ But the same quadro lists 'Manequim — Representa e desfila usando seu corpo para exibir roupas e adereços'. A FASHION try-on host displaying clothes on her body sits close to that text. The art. 3 caput also reaches employers using artists for 'mensagens publicitárias'. So the risk is low for beauty and non-zero for fashion try-on lives. ADPF 293 (PGR vs the registration requirements) was pulled from the STF agenda in Dec 2019; its current status is UNVERIFIED. (c) Ordinary (non-artist) recruitment for a fee: no licence was located for a firm that charges only the EMPLOYER. CNAE 7810-8/00 'seleção e agenciamento de mão-de-obra'. Charging CANDIDATES is attacked by the MPT (Conjur, Nov 2024; search summary only, page did not load): never charge the host. (d) Simples: LC 123 §5-I XI puts 'agenciamento, EXCETO de mão de obra' in Anexo V, so agenciamento de mão de obra is carved out of Anexo V. Art. 17 XII bars only 'cessão ou locação de mão-de-obra', which she must never do. The likely classification is the residual Anexo III (6% at faixa 1). UNVERIFIED with an accountant; the 6–15,5% range stands. (e) PJ hosts: she creates no liability as long as she only recruits. The brand contracts and pays the host; she never invoices for, pays, supervises or schedules the host's work. If she did, it would be cessão de mão-de-obra: a C3 breach, a Simples bar (art. 17 XII), and joint-liability exposure. Pejotização risk on a host who works 'Seg a Sex 08h–17h45' belongs to the brand, not to her. (f) Audition tapes are images of candidates, so they need written image/LGPD consent to be shared with the client. REPAIR: sell 'seleção de vendedor(a) para vendas ao vivo', never 'agenciamento de artistas/modelos'. Exclude fashion try-on roles, or have the client hire under a sales CBO. One accountant question on the annex.
retention: No direct turnover measure exists; UNVERIFIED. Indirect evidence points to high churn. (1) Pay is low-base plus commission: R$1.620–2.500 base in most ads; Fantasias Carol R$1.620–2.066; Perfumistta R$1.900 + R$2.000–7.000 commission. (2) Contract forms: 16/84 ads mention PJ, and Comunica RH lists its roles as 'Temporário'. (3) Serial reposting: Preçolandia 6 postings between 2 hours and 2 weeks old; Fantasias Carol 3 over a month; Malibu 3 in 3 days; Perfumistta 2 in a week; Dahuer 2; Legend Parfum again on InfoJobs 11 months after its first ad. (4) The hours are long: BIGBR asks for '3 e 5 horas ou mais por live', and IT Bolsa runs '8 horas por dia, com dois apresentadores se revezando'. The market STANDARD guarantee is 30 days, and Empregga sells +30 or +60 as a paid option. W2E's free 60-day replacement gives away a priced add-on on the most churn-prone role in the file. Cash cost is ~0, since her COGS is her time. Hours cost: a replacement reuses the shortlist but still needs ~3–5 h (re-audition, client call). At 30–50% early exits (assumption) that is +1–2,5 h per paid hire, about 10–15% more hours and no revenue. It does not eat the margin; it eats the binding constraint. REPAIR: 30 days included, 60 days as a +R$300 option, void if the client changes the brief, pay, schedule or product.

arithmetic.hours_per_hire: W2E's 6–8 h assumes every search yields a paid hire and no sales time. My bottom-up count per SEARCH: sourcing on TikTok LIVE replays, ~20 candidates viewed, 2–3 h · DM/WhatsApp outreach and scheduling with no-shows 1,5–2 h · 5 video auditions ~30 min each incl. setup 2,5–3 h · tape edit and shortlist 1–1,5 h · client brief and debrief calls 1–1,5 h · invoice/chase 0,5 h ⇒ 8,5–11,5 h. Assume 60–80% of searches end in a hire (UNVERIFIED): 10,6–19 h per PAID hire. Add Portuguese sales at ~2,5 h per new client with ~50% repeat, +1–1,5 h. Add replacement drag, +1–2,5 h. ⇒ ≈12,5–24 h per paid hire, central ~15 h, about 2× W2E.
arithmetic.hires_needed: Net bar R$10.359–12.949/month (US$2.000–2.500 at PTAX 5,1795). Gross needed = (net + stack)/(1 − tax): R$11.446 (Anexo III 6%, stack R$400) to R$16.271 (Anexo V 15,5%, stack R$800). At R$2.000/hire that is 5,7–8,1 hires/month. At R$1.500 (Empregga-parity) 7,6–10,8. At R$1.200 (55% of a R$2.200 base) 9,5–13,6. Hours: at R$2.000, 71–195 h; at R$1.500, 95–260 h, against 87 h. Only the single most optimistic corner fits (R$2.000, 12,5 h/hire, Anexo III ⇒ 71 h). Hours-bound ceiling at the market price: 82 h ÷ 15 h ≈ 5,5 hires × R$1.500 = R$8.200 gross ⇒ ≈R$7.300 net ≈ US$1.410/month, BELOW the bar even with unlimited demand.
arithmetic.pool: MEASURED (not the 728 fuzzy count, which is ~9× the real listing stock): 84 unique live-host listings, ~54 distinct hiring entities, 51 with a post in the last 30 days, on the one aggregator that indexes these boards. Plus 2 on Gupy (Pacco, Dafyne; Dafyne is also on the aggregator). Beauty/fragrance/fashion/accessories ≈ 14–16 of 54; live agencies ≈ 7. Flow assumption: 45–80 host hires/month visible, ×1–2 for channels not indexed (LinkedIn, Instagram, WhatsApp) ⇒ 45–160 hires/month nationally (UNVERIFIED; W2E assumed 150–300). PAID flow: only ~10–12% use an intermediary ⇒ ~4–21 paid searches/month ⇒ R$5–31k/month of placement fees nationally at R$1.200–1.500.
arithmetic.pool_div4: Paid pool ÷ 4 = R$1,2–7,9k/month against a bar of R$11,4–16,3k gross ⇒ FAILS by 1,5–14×. Only if she converts free-posters does it pass: whole flow 45–160 × R$1.500 = R$67–240k ÷ 4 = R$17–60k. That requires creating paid demand among the ~88–90% who already chose the free route.
arithmetic.share: 5,7–13,6 hires/month = 4–30% of ALL live-host hires in Brazil, and ~27–300% of the currently intermediated flow (4,5–21 paid searches/month). In the C8 niche alone (beauty/fashion, ~14–16 employers/month) it is 35–95% of every hire. It needs to be ≤20–33% under THE MARKET-MULTIPLE RULE. FAILS unless the free-poster conversion is proven.

c8: The best C8 fit in Hunt 6 on the SELECTION half. She sat through castings for years; she can see who holds energy for four hours, who reads credible holding a perfume, and who looks expensive on a phone camera. The buyer judges the tape with its own eyes, so no credential or belief is needed, and C2 holds because auditions are private calls. But the year-three work is ~80% recruiter grind: DMing creators, chasing no-shows, rescheduling, chasing fees from small e-commerce owners, and replacing a host who quit in week three. The placements are R$1.620–2.500 PJ jobs with 3–8 h daily lives, and she will be rejecting 20-somethings for a living from the other side of the table. Empregga's own framing, 4 vagas/month = R$3.032 'where most recruiters start', is what the craft looks like at scale. Persistence is plausible but likely to feel like 'an RH agency' rather than 'casting' by year three. Moderate, not strong.
synergy_with_lead: Weak in volume, useful as a question. Measured overlap: of ~54 host-hiring employers, only Vizzela (51 ANVISA notifications with a notification date in the last 12 months, holder DDP Indústria) and Perfumistta (23, holder Antunes Cosméticos) are active ANVISA launchers (~4%). Fleurity has 0 recent; 'Malibu' in the ANVISA file is Malibu Premium haircare, NOT Malibu Glasses. Talent & Tech's hidden client is a cosmetics group. The reverse overlap (how many of the ~300 own-brand launchers run daily lives with a hired host) is UNMEASURED. The needs are sequential: visuals at ~T−79 days before shelf, a host at go-live. So one Portuguese call can pitch both, and the cross-sell might add 0–1 hire/month. It does not change either verdict. A bundle ('launch kit + launch host + first live') drifts into the full live-commerce agency seat that Tokz, Score Media and StarLive already occupy with in-house hosts (C3). Best use: add two questions to O LANÇAMENTO's 20-call test ('vocês fazem live no TikTok Shop? quem apresenta e como contrataram — pagaram alguém?'). That measures the overlap and a real placement fee at R$0.
strongest_version: DEAD as a standalone business at the bar: the paid pool fails ÷4 by 1,5–14×, and the hours-bound ceiling at the market price is ~US$1.410/month even with unlimited demand. The strongest surviving form is a MARGINAL add-on, not a company: 'CASTING DE LIVE', sold only inside O LANÇAMENTO calls and to employers paying ≥R$3.500 base (Tec-Do R$4.000–5.500, IT Bolsa R$4.200–5.000, Oceanix up to R$5.000, Jetdisc R$3.500, Vitrine Digital up to R$3.500; about 5–7 of 54). Price at the market convention: 50–55% of the host's monthly base, minimum R$1.500, success-only, 30-day replacement included, 60 days +R$300. At a R$4.000–5.000 base that gives R$2.000–2.750 per hire, the only segment where W2E's R$2.000 matches market practice. Scope: 'seleção de vendedor(a) para vendas ao vivo' in beauty/fragrance/accessories; no fashion try-on roles (the Manequim/Decreto 82.385 art. 5 risk); never pay, invoice for or schedule the host (C3, LC 123 art. 17 XII). Sourcing stays her edge: people already live-selling on TikTok LIVE, plus a taped audition on the client's own SKU.
honest_floor_usd_month: US$200–1.000 (1–3 paid hires/month at R$1.500–2.000 ⇒ R$1.500–6.000 gross ⇒ net ≈R$1.010–5.240 at 6% Simples and a R$400 stack, PTAX 5,1795). Hours-bound ceiling ≈US$1.400 at R$1.500/hire, or ≈US$2.300 only at R$2.000 and 12,5 h/hire, which needs 6,6 paid hires/month, more than the observed national paid flow's lower bound. Below the lead's US$700–1.500 floor.
next_test: R$0, Portuguese calls, 14 days. It runs alongside O LANÇAMENTO's test and does not replace it. (1) Call all ~51 entities that posted a live-host role in the last 30 days (list in work/aud5/tj_detail.json). Skip the intermediaries; call their end clients where named. Offer: 3 hosts, already live-selling on TikTok, auditioned on your product within 10 business days; R$1.500 or 50% of the base, whichever is higher, only on hire; 30-day replacement. Also ask every employer: 'já pagaram recrutador para essa vaga? quanto?' That yields the first real live-host placement fee. (2) Add the two host questions to O LANÇAMENTO's 20 launcher calls. (3) For the first commission, time every hour of the search, since hours are the binding constraint.
bar: Committed in advance. ALIVE only if ≥5 of ~51 (≥10%) commission a paid search at ≥R$1.500 within 14 days, i.e., she at least DOUBLES the observed ~10–12% intermediated share among employers who already chose the free route; AND ≥2 hires are invoiced within 45 days; AND the first search takes ≤12 h end to end. Fewer than 3 commissions, OR a fee accepted below R$1.200, OR >18 h per search ⇒ STOP; record the price answers.
unverified: Any observed fee paid for recruiting a live host (none found; the 5–6 recruiters placing hosts publish no fee)

corrections_to_W2E: The '728 vagas' figure is the aggregator's fuzzy keyword count. Paginated to the end on four queries, there are 84 genuine live-host listings and ~54 distinct employers (~9× fewer)
Recruta Simples is a self-serve multiposting tool ('Anuncie sua vaga em +100 sites com um clique', 5-day free trial), not a recruitment firm. StarLive recruits in-house
The consent price-holder belongs to the HOST (wage R$1.620–5.500), not the intermediary. Consent is abundant: 500 mil criadores, ads hiring 'sem experiência'
Decreto 82.385 art. 5 par. único is stricter than Lei 6.533 art. 4: only Lei 6.019 firms (capital ≥R$100.000) may place artists. This is not a mere filing
The 60-day free replacement exceeds the market standard: Empregga includes 30 days and sells +30/+60 as options
Hours per paid hire are ~12,5–24 h, not 6–8 h
The BR TSP 'Mass Recruiting' category is SELLER onboarding, not host recruiting
